summary: Iteration 73 — validation of 2 tasks: (1) /api/admin/pdf-test/{product} now protected by require_admin (Supabase JWT), with frontend gate on /admin/pdf-test (redirect anonymous, 'Accès réservé' non-admin); (2) natal_pdf_v2.py refactor with build_with_toc 2-pass rendering. All 14 backend pytest cases pass (auth gate on 6 products, bad-token → 401, public /api/pdf-preview/{kabbale,astrocartographie} remain 200, regression on /credits /choix /astrocartographie /livres /outils/tarot). All 3 frontend Playwright flows pass: anon → redirect /connexion?redirect=/admin/pdf-test, test user (non-admin) → admin-pdf-test-denied visible with 'Accès réservé aux administrateurs', admin@ → full dashboard with 6 cards + firstname/partner inputs. natal_pdf_v2 direct fixture render produces 8.3 MB PDF (>500 KB target) without import/build errors.
critical_code_review_comments: require_admin gate is properly wired via Depends(require_admin) in pdf_test_admin.py — returns 403 on missing/invalid Bearer token (verified curl).
Frontend /admin/pdf-test triple gate order is correct: authLoading spinner → !user redirect → !isAdmin denied → dashboard. Uses useAuth().session.access_token for Bearer.

natal_pdf_v2._build_story is a closure inside build_natal_pdf_v2 — the 2-pass build_with_toc invokes it twice (dry-run captures chapter_marker page numbers via page_map, real pass injects into TOC entries). Clean and idiomatic.
Minor : AdminPdfTest.js line 26 isAdmin fallback uses email 'admin@plume-astrale.fr' as heuristic — acceptable safety-net but the real source of truth is profile.is_admin from Supabase.
No _id ObjectId serialization risk — only Supabase postgrest client used.
seed_data_creation: None — fixtures generated on-the-fly by _fixture() in pdf_test_admin.py
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin PDF test dashboard is now fully secured. Backend endpoint returns 403 without valid admin JWT (all 6 products). Frontend triple-gates (loading/anon/non-admin). natal_pdf_v2 refactored to 2-pass build_with_toc works — TOC entries carry {page: <int>} pointing to real chapter_marker page numbers. To retest natal PDF TOC pagination visually, admin user must open /admin/pdf-test → click 'Ouvrir' on Thème Natal card; the note dispatched via fetch(Bearer) opens PDF blob in new tab. If book_data (GPT enrichment) is None, the TOC block is skipped (bd=False path), so full 2-pass numbering only shows when book_data is provided.
